run_export_rasters_pipeline: run the Apache Beam pipeline to export inference results as raster tiles into Google Earth Engine
create_upload_task: create an upload task to push raster files to a Google Earth Engine asset
generate_utm_metadata: generate a DataFrame of UTM zone metadata including bounding boxes and EPSG codes
extract_data_from_npz: extract and preprocess prediction arrays from an NPZ file with optional channel, temperature, and divisor transforms
read_and_split_data: read inference data from NPZ files and split plots into spatial tiles by UTM zone coordinates
